summary: Gilam Seok works in Buddhist studies. He earned a bachelor's degree from Hankuk University of Foreign Studies and a doctorate from Dongguk University WISE Campus, where he joined the Department of Buddhist Studies, and has been a member of Geumgang University.

Gilbert Lazard was a French scholar of Iranian and Central Asian studies and linguistics. Educated at the École Normale Supérieure (1940), he held posts at the École Pratique des Hautes Études (~1951-1990) and the University of Paris (~1958-1981).

Gilbert Slater was a historian and Indologist who earned a doctorate at the London School of Economics. He served as Principal of Ruskin College (1909-1915) and was appointed the first Professor of Indian Economics at the University of Madras in 1915.

Gilbert Zhe Chen is a historian, Sinologist, and Buddhist studies scholar. He completed his PhD at Washington University in St. Louis (2012-2019) and became an associate professor at Towson University in 2019.
Gilberte de Coral-Rémusat was an archaeologist and Indologist. She studied at the École du Louvre and the École Pratique des Hautes Études under Jean Przyluski, Paul Pelliot, and Paul Masson-Oursel.

Gilles Tarabout is an Indology and religious studies scholar who studied under Madeleine Biardeau. As attested in 2004, he held positions at the CNRS as a senior fellow, EHESS, and the Fondation Maison des Sciences de l'Homme as program director.

Gillian R. Hart was a linguist and Indologist who studied at the University of Reading, Lady Margaret Hall, and the University of Oxford under Thomas Burrow. She was a lecturer in classics at Aberystwyth University (1960-1969) and lectured at Durham University (1969-1993).

Gin Ling Liu is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed a Doctor of Philosophy at the University of Hong Kong under the doctoral supervision of Jing Yin, also studying under Hsing Yun, both attested in 2008.

Giorgio Renato Franci was an Italian scholar of Indology, linguistics, and philosophy. He studied at the University of Bologna under Luigi Heilmann (~1952-1956) and later held an academic post there (~1966-2008).

Giovanni Gentile was an Italian philosopher educated at the Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa and the University of Florence. He served as professor at Palermo, Pisa, and Sapienza University of Rome, and headed institutions including the Scuola Normale Superiore and ISMEO.

Giovanni Vacca was an Italian Sinologist and historian who earned his doctorate at the University of Genoa and studied in Florence. He taught at the University of Florence (1910) and held posts at Sapienza University of Rome (1911-1921; 1923-1948).

Giovanni Verardi is an archaeologist and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Allahabad, Banaras Hindu, and Gorakhpur universities. He held posts at Ca' Foscari, Bologna, and L'Orientale, alongside visiting roles at Collège de France, Seijo, Kyoto, and ICPBS.
Girijesh Dhar Dwivedi is an Indology and philosophy scholar. He completed an Acharya degree at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (2010-2011) and pursued a PhD at SunRise University (2019-2026).

Girindrasekhar Bose was an Indian psychoanalyst who studied at Presidency University, Calcutta Medical College, and the University of Calcutta. He served as Professor of Experimental Psychology at the University of Calcutta (1917-1949) and president of the Indian Psychoanalytic Society (1922-1953).

Girolamo Donati was an Italian Indologist who studied under Angelo De Gubernatis. He served as libero docente di sanscrito at the University of Florence (~1889-1901) and as conservator at the Museo Indiano.

Gisbert Combaz was an art historian and Sinologist who studied at the Université libre de Bruxelles and under Louis de La Vallée Poussin. He taught at Ixelles, Université Nouvelle de Bruxelles, and the Académie Royale des Beaux-Arts.

Gisela Emma Full is a scholar in Buddhist studies and philosophy who studied at the universities of Würzburg and Münster. As attested in 2013, she held research fellow positions at European University Viadrina and the Samueli Institute.

Gisela Freund was an archaeologist who studied at the German university of Prague (~1939-1944). She served as Head of the Department of Prehistory at the University of Erlangen-Nuremberg from around 1969 to 1985.

Gisho Nakano was a scholar of Indology and Buddhist studies. Educated at the University of Tokyo under Junjirō Takakusu and at Kyushu University, he held professorships at Peking University and Koyasan University, where he also served as president.
Giti Dutt is an archaeology and history researcher attested in 2026 as a PhD student at the Australian National University, studying under doctoral supervisor Assa Doron.
